title: Unrecognized and unauthorized transactions - explained
content: An unfamiliar transaction can indicate fraud or an unfamiliar merchant description. Review it promptly through a verified banking channel and protect affected access if misuse is suspected; do not wait for a chatbot to confirm that fraud occurred.
